subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be rebuilt as the narrow pairing fix before merge, or should maintainers intentionally carry the current cross-repo drift in this branch?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and conflicting XL head make this a branch/merge-risk decision rather than an auto-close or routine contributor follow-up.

options.title: Rebuild Narrow Pairing Branch
options.body: Keep the useful allowFrom fix but reset the branch to only the pairing source and test files before merge review resumes.

options.title: Accept Current Drift Intentionally
options.body: Maintainers can keep the broad workflow/dependency/app/generated changes only if they are intentionally reviewing this PR as a large integration branch.

options.title: Pause Until Recreated
options.body: If the branch cannot be repaired cleanly, close or pause it and reopen a fresh narrow PR carrying the same pairing commits.

recommendation.title: Rebuild Narrow Pairing Branch
recommendation.body: Keep the useful allowFrom fix but reset the branch to only the pairing source and test files before merge review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the assignee and has both prior pairing-area history and ownership of the current maintainer-labeled branch.
